Immutable Uniswap V2 pair (WORLDBANK/WETH) used as the primary AMM market.

Maximum allowed tx.gasprice during launch.
Mapping of tx.origin to last block number for transfer-delay limiting.
Flag enforcing one purchase per block per tx.origin.
Aggregated buy/sell total dev fee percentages (buyTotalDevFees/sellTotalDevFees).

External router buyback swap accepting any amount of tokens for the owner's ETH.
Fee/token amount arithmetic (mul, div, += and amount -= fees) in _transfer.
Single _mint of the entire 1e24 total supply to the deployer in the constructor.

Sum of accrued dev and marketing token amounts.
